column1: # THE RECORD BANDS: every fidelity row one daily record can be read the model's way, with that
# record's own sampling spread -- where the statistic lands over moving one-year-block resamples of
# the record.  A verdict row that carries a band misses when the model falls outside its joint band
# (jointLo..jointHi) and reports its percentile among the resamples, and its `real` is this file's
# `record`.  `RecordBandSuite` /
# `record_band_tests` re-derive the shipped `RecordBand` literals and the typical-year anchors from
# this file.  Editing a row moves the shipped bands.
# record     the row's statistic on the whole window, by `seriesReadings` / `series_readings`: the
#            functions the model reads a path with.  The typical year's is `yearVolPhaseMean`, the
#            median-year vol averaged over all 252 block phases: on one series the phase is worth as
#            much as the gap the row measures (QQQ 18.2 to 21.5; calendar years, which the anchor
#            used to read, 18.3).
# p0..p100   the statistic over 20000 resamples, each the window's own length, built from whole
#            252-session blocks at uniformly drawn starts (`NumPyRng`, seed 20260918) and read the
#            same way; `pctile`'s index rule.
# jointC     the joint band's half-width in rank, c: per resample the largest distance of any of the
# jointLo    window's rows' mid-ranks from 1/2, at its 1 - alpha quantile; each row's band is its
# jointHi    resamples at 1/2 - c and 1/2 + c (`record_band_joint` / `recordBandJoint`).  A set's
#            rows miss together at most 10% of the time: alpha is 0.10 split over the set's record
#            windows by their rows (QQQ's 16 at 0.0842, its 2 DFF rows at 0.0105 and its TLT row at 0.0053;
#            the S&P's 14 at 0.0737, its 2 century rows, its 2 DFF rows and its TLT row likewise).  Each row's own p5..p95 held the QQQ resamples all at once 42.7% of the time.
# nasdaq  QQQ, Yahoo Finance's adjusted closes (retrieved 2026-10-04): daily log returns
#         1999-03-11..2026-08-20, the window the Nasdaq set's levels were measured over.  The file's
#         first row is the anchor price and carries no return.
# sp500   CRSP value-weighted US market total return from Ken French's
#         F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily (202608): Mkt-RF + RF compounded into an index without a
#         leading 1.0, then its log returns, so the window's first session drops out.  1954-2026
#         for every row but clustering, which the set reads over the century, 1926-2026.  Read
#         LAG-FREE: the daily returns through 1999-03-10 with the stale-price lag removed, an MA(2)
#         inversion fitted per calendar five-year block (`unlag_returns`; `-recorded` reads them as
#         printed).  QQQ and TLT are funds, read as printed.
# DFF    the daily effective federal funds rate (FRED's full run, fredgraph.csv?id=DFF, fetched
#         2026-09-25), the rate rows' record for both sets, read on Monday-Friday dates over the set's own
#         equity window.  A level, so no session drops out.
# TLT     the bond row's record for both sets: Yahoo Finance's adjusted closes (retrieved
# WHERE A LOSS TARGET IS NOT THIS RECORD, and stays as it is (the verdict carries both):
#   variance ratio 60d     1.00 in both sets, a theory value: the model has no mean-reversion
#                          channel
#   sp500 crashes/century  20.7, between the century's 19.2 and 1954-2026's 24.9
#   sp500 median depth %   -21.5, the mean of the two middle episodes of 18; the model's median
#                          takes the upper middle, -21.0
# The S&P's equity vol (16.8), kurtosis (20.5) and return per vol (0.643) targets are this file's
# lag-free 1954-2026 records.
# vol-timing edge pts/yr   the consumer's canonical volatility-timing rule (`volTimingOf` / `vol_timing_of`):
#            hold the index when its 24-session realized vol is below the series' own 60th
#            percentile of it, cash at 0 at or above the 80th, keep the position between, decided
#            on the vol through t and held over t+1; the rule's log growth minus buy-and-hold's,
#            points a year, from the first full window on.  The first CONDITIONAL row; anchor-free
#            by construction.  Added 2026-09-24 (PLAN item 33); every earlier row's record and
#            percentiles reproduce the 2026-09-18 file, the joint bands span the new row.
# short rate %             the rate path's mean, percent (`rateReadings` / `rate_readings`), and
# rate floor share %       the share of its sessions under 0.50%, percent: the record's carry and its
#            time at the zero bound, which the bond's carry, the equity's markdown and a levered
#            fund's financing read.  Added 2026-09-25 (PLAN item 34); every earlier row's record and
#            percentiles reproduce the 2026-09-24 file, and every joint band is re-split over 15 rows.
# variance ratio 120d      the 60-day row's statistic at 120 and 250 sessions (`varianceRatio` /
# variance ratio 250d      `variance_ratio`): the long end consumer request 1 grades, where QQQ's ratio
#            rises with the horizon and the worlds' falls.  Added 2026-09-26; every earlier row's
#            record and percentiles reproduce the 2026-09-25 file, every joint band re-split over 18.
# variance ratio 20d       the same ratio at 20 sessions, the short rung the retired variance-ratio profile gate
#            boxed; the calibrated membership rule places it with the other rungs.  Added 2026-10-18; every
#            earlier row's record and percentiles reproduce the 2026-10-04 file, every joint band re-split over 19.
# Generated by `rust/src/bin/record_bands.rs` (twin: `jsrc/recordBands.sc`), measured 2026-09-26,
# the QQQ and TLT rows re-read 2026-10-04, the 20-day row and every joint band 2026-10-18 from the same files,
# the CRSP rows re-read lag-free 2026-10-23.  -yahoo files are `date,adj_close,dlog_adj_close`, one row
# a session, the first carrying no return:
#   record_bands -set nasdaq -series QQQ -yahoo <QQQ.csv> -from 1999-03-10 -to 2026-08-20 -of 19
#   record_bands -set nasdaq -series DFF -fred <FRED DFF, full run> -rate
#   record_bands -set sp500 -series DFF -fred <FRED DFF, full run> -rate -from 1954-07-01 -to 2026-06-30 -of 19
#   record_bands -set nasdaq|sp500 -series TLT -yahoo <TLT.csv> -bond -from 2002-07-30 -to 2026-08-03 -of 19
# The QQQ and TLT files end where they stand; to read past those dates each continues on its published
# proxy, spliced after the last date (`-splice FILE -at DATE`): QQQ on Ken French's daily HiTec industry,
# `-splice <french>/10_Industry_Portfolios_Daily.CSV -column HiTec -at 2026-08-20 -to <later>`; TLT on the
# 20-year constant-maturity Treasury built from FRED's DGS20, `-splice <FRED DGS20> -at 2026-08-03 -to <later>`.
#   record_bands -set sp500 -series CRSP -french <data>/french/F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily.csv
#       -from 1954-01-04 -to 2026-06-30 -rows <every row but the two clustering rows> -of 19
#   record_bands -set sp500 -series CRSP -french <same> -from 1926-07-01 -to 2026-06-30
#       -rows "clustering lag 1,clustering lag 20" -of 19

# own joint band. It replaces the mechanism gate that held a floor at this band's edge.
